heading: Treasure Hunt
intro: Crack the riddle, find the spot, scan the QR. Fastest team to the treasure wins.
emptyText: When a trip you booked has a treasure hunt, it shows up here on the day.
scanMiss: That QR isn't part of a hunt you're booked on.
title: Find the treasure
rule1: One clock per team. It starts when your team is created, and stops when anyone scans the final QR.
rule2: Stops unlock in order. Each QR gives you the riddle to the next one.
rule3: Scan with this page or your phone camera, or type the code printed under the QR.
rule4: Stuck? Your team has {n} lifeline(s) to reveal an extra hint.
rule5: Leave every QR where it is for the teams behind you.
closedText: The organisers will open it on the day. Keep this page handy.
pendingScan: Stop scanned! Join your team first and it will be claimed.
photoAlt: Close-up of where the QR is hidden
lifelineConfirm: Spend one of your team's lifelines on this stop? It can't be undone.
noLifelines: Your team has used all its lifelines.
scannerBlocked: Camera blocked. Close this and type the code printed under the QR.
already: Your team already cleared that stop.
invalid: That code doesn't match any stop. Check the letters under the QR.
otherRoute: That QR is on {route}. Your team is on another route.
wrongOrder: That's stop {scanned}. Stops unlock in order, so find stop {expected} first.
closedScan: The hunt is closed, so stops can no longer be claimed.
failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noFinishers: No team has found the treasure yet.
newText: One person per team taps start, then up to {n} people join with the team ID. Pick your bus and your team gets its route, and your clock starts straight away.
joinText: Type the team ID from your teammate's phone to join them. You share one clock and one route.
pickTeamId: Type the team ID your teammate sees on their screen.
teamNotFound: There's no team with that ID on this trip. Check it with your teammates.
shareId: Share this ID so your teammates can join you.
leaveConfirm: Tap again to leave this team
cantLeave: Your team has already cleared a stop, so you can no longer leave it.
pickBus: Choose the bus you came on.
chooseRoute: Which route is your team on?
teamFull: That team is full ({n} people). Start a new team instead.
selfieRule1: One clock per team. It starts when your team is created, and stops when your team has a selfie at every stop.
selfieRule2: Every clue shows from the start. Find the stops in any order you like.
selfieRule3: At each stop, take a team selfie with the place clearly behind you, or attach a photo.
selfieRule5: The organisers check every selfie. If one is rejected, retake it there and your clock keeps running until you do.
selfiePending: Sent · the organisers will check it
selfieRejected: Rejected · take a new selfie here
selfieFailed: The selfie couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
selfieTooBig: That photo is too large. Please use one under 12 MB.
selfieHuntNoQr: This hunt uses selfies, not QR codes.
closedSelfie: The hunt is closed, so selfies can no longer be sent.
cameraBlocked: This page can't use the camera. Open your phone's camera instead.
underReview: The organisers are still checking your selfies.
verifiedAll: Every selfie approved by the organisers.
needAnswer: Selfie in · now send your answer
needSelfie: Answer in · now take your selfie
